{{Top}}
'''Sarrassian iron''' was a material that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrassia/Legends|Sarrassia]], in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ayanos Bactra]] [[Conquest of Sarrassia|ended]] a religious conflict on Sarrassia, so that he could obtain access to the world's Sarassian iron deposits.
